purpose: Teach: エクセル/シャンパン/猛暑/バスケ/棚田/日の出/レプリカ/特訓

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 宿題、エクセルでまとめてる。
lines.en: I'm organizing my homework in Excel.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, eyes on the screen. Light, conversational pace. No performance—just saying what she's doing. Slightly distracted but present.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 家のお祝い、シャンパンの代わりにジュースだけど。
lines.en: My family's celebrating the move with juice instead of champagne.
lines.style: Dry, self-aware half-smile in the voice. Gentle deflation on 'juice'—not complaining, just stating the small reality. Even tone, grounded.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今夏、猛暑予想、エアコン、念入りに掃除しなきゃ。
lines.en: This summer's supposed to be brutal. I should clean the AC properly.
lines.style: Slightly worried undertone, thinking out loud. Steady pace, practical. A hint of resignation—she knows it's a task. Trailing into almost a note-to-self at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: バスケ部、夏合宿で特訓するんだ。
lines.en: Basketball team has intensive training camp over summer.
lines.style: Quiet energy underneath. Not boasting, just stating it. Light uptick on 'intensive'—he's steeling himself. Straightforward, no dramatics.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行で、棚田の景色、見られるって。
lines.en: On the school trip, I heard we can see the rice terraces.
lines.style: Brightness breaking through naturally. Conversational, animated without performing. Slight rise in pitch on 'terraces'—genuine interest. Forward momentum.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 山頂で日の出、見られるかな。
lines.en: Think we'll catch the sunrise from the summit?
lines.style: Softer than before. A quiet wish underneath the question. Gentle, uncertain—not quite hoping out loud but close. Eyes somewhere distant for a moment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 博物館の刀のレプリカ、触ってみたい。
lines.en: I want to touch the museum's replica sword.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, like she's just realized she wants this. Open, engaged tone. Slightly forward-leaning energy. Not childish—just unguarded about what interests her.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 特訓、サボらないようにね。
lines.en: Don't slack off on those drills.
lines.style: Dry teasing, but with a thread of real care underneath. Light, almost affectionate. Like he's giving her something to hold him accountable to as well. Closes the loop gently.
